title: Vermont Statutes Annotated, Title 3 (Executive), Chapter 16 - Vermont Employees' Retirement System
verified_how: fetched https://legislature.vermont.gov/statutes/chapter/03/016 (HTTP 200): headings 'Title 3 : Executive' and 'Chapter 016 : Vermont Employees' Retirement System', subchapter heading 'Subchapter 001 : GENERALLY' listing s 455 (Definitions), 456 (Name and date of establishment), 457 (Members), 458 (Creditable service; military service), 459 (Normal and early retirement), 459a (Restoration of service) onward; the Title 3 index page gives 'Chapter 016 ... Contains: ss 455 - 495'. I also fetched https://legislature.vermont.gov/statutes/chapter/03/015 (HTTP 200) to disambiguate the identically named Chapter 015: every entry there reads 'Repealed. 1971, No. 231 (Adj. Sess.), s 5', confirming Chapter 016 is the operative chapter. Every page of the Vermont Statutes Online carries the currency line 'The Statutes below include the actions of the 2025 session of the General Assembly.' and the caveat 'NOTE: The Vermont Statutes Online is an unofficial copy of the Vermont Statutes Annotated that is provided as a convenience.' No repeal marker appears on the cited provisions; repealed sections elsewhere in the same chapters are explicitly flagged 'Repealed. <act cite>', so the absence of that marker is meaningful.
notes: Old-age, survivors and disability insurance itself is federal (42 U.S.C. ch. 7); this is the state-employee pension scheme and the principal Vermont pension statute. Teachers are under 16 V.S.A. ch. 55, and 3 V.S.A. ch. 19 (Social Security for State and Municipal Employees) covers federal coverage agreements.
